title: Chocolate Lush
ingredients: 16 oz whipped cream/frozen whipped topping, divided
2 (3.4 oz boxes) instant chocolate pudding mixes
instructions: In a stand mixer, combine the butter, flour, and sugar.
Pack into the bottom of a greased 9x13 pan and bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. Allow the crust to cool completely.
In a stand mixer, combine the cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth. Fold in 8 oz of whipped topping until smooth. Spread onto the cooled crust.
In a medium sized bowl, whisk the pudding mixes with the milk until thick. Spread over the cream cheese layer.
Top with remaining whipped topping and refrigerate until ready to serve.
notes: Also known as 'sex in a pan' or 'Robert Redford dessert' in some circles. Can swap chocolate pudding for pistachio, lemon, or coconut. Some commenters add butterscotch pudding with pecans, or finely chopped pecans in the crust. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. Found via Facebook reel from Cooking with Karli; full recipe was in the first comment, linking to cookingwithkarli.com.
